findings.title: Sort declarative plain-patch field mappings as a semantic set
findings.evidence: patch() collects record.fields directly into mappings without sorting. The pinned actual migration CLI emits Todo.patch_todo mappings in [title,status,due_at] order, rather than [due_at,status,title]. These rows describe optional same-name source-field to target-field associations and symbolic supplied conditions, not an authored sequence of initializer evaluations.
findings.contract_basis: The accepted field/output recipe explicitly requires semantic-set sorting; approval-protocol.md v5 canonicalization sorts set-like collections while preserving ordered syntax tokens and witness paths. Outer BTreeMaps do not canonicalize this nested array.
findings.impact: A permutation of the same checked patch-record declarations permutes the mapping set and changes the update/source/route contracts solely through traversal order. This is a normalization gap, not missing patch writes, checker weakening, a forged origin proof or a runtime permission vulnerability.
findings.smallest_correction: Sort the mapping rows by exact checked patch/target field identity before emission. Add a producer regression with two equivalent Input patch declarations in opposite field order, preferably also the paired Value case; compare the normalized mapping rows and their update contract. Whole source/provenance digests should still differ because authored bytes differ. Do not sort initializer expressions, statements, positional arguments, page predicates/order/cursor tuples or witness paths.
findings.reproduction: jadpo/target/debug/jadpo approval examples/golden-todo-migration | jq '.canonical.after.impact.field_source_contracts.operations["Todo.patch_todo"].contracts[] | select(.kind == "update_fields") | .contract.patch.mappings | map(.source_patch_field.field)'

assessment.producer_completeness: Exhaustive matches cover every current checked Statement and Expression variant. Catalogue covers Entity/Value/Input/Output records, enum payload fields and scalar aliases. Already-qualified flattened callable names are used once; unreachable owners remain emitted with explicit no-route status. Nine groups assert expected facts independently of the emitter, not only renderer equality.
assessment.type_evidence_and_synthetic_names: Exact source/range observations coalesce identical strings and explicitly preserve missing/conflicting observations. Declared AST contracts remain separate from observed display evidence, including the valid page expression lacking an outer inference row. Exact source-local generated lookup keys normalize inline Object and route path/header shapes in values and IDs; authored tokens and synthetic-looking authored names remain unchanged. Unknown or ambiguous associations are explicitly unresolved rather than guessed or leaked. Four internal tests passed.
assessment.patch_semantics: Input and Value use exact unique patch occurrence evidence, not variable spelling or field-set guessing. All optional patch fields map to checked same-name entity fields with symbolic per-field supplied conditions. Checked inherited nullability preserves present-null versus omitted/no assignment. Derived supplied-field paths and values remain distinct. Missing/conflicting association produces a whole unresolved patch, never an empty write set. Only mapping-set sorting remains required by FO-I01.
assessment.targets_and_origins: Constructor fields retain checked nominal target types/references and nested target paths; syntax and observed nominal types explicitly do not prove database origins. Whole aliases and call results remain whole-value boundaries with origin resolution not performed. Nominal private field policy reads are retained without treating them as resolved runtime dataflow.
assessment.conditions_and_queries: If/match/outcome arms, failure propagation/rejection, query/update/delete missing, patch empty, conflicts and supplied conditions remain symbolic. Explicit success/failure outcome pattern kinds survive. Page operators and order/cursor tuples preserve actual order. Optional include has null authored order/pagination; bounded-many include retains actual limit/offset/order. Lifecycle pointer is Todo.lifecycle.transition.delete and sql_writes remains not_inferred.
assessment.routes_and_identity: Domain-separated owner plus build-local structural addresses identify source rows. Semantic call endpoints drive sorted/deduplicated adjacency and cycle-safe breadth-first deterministic may-call witnesses; no NodeId/byte offset is exported as a field-contract identity. Root/owned/inline operations and route surfaces remain separate. No insertion/rename-stability or executed-path proof is asserted.
assessment.response_separation: Parent adds only module/facet extraction, leaving actor_sources and existing effect/admission comparison inputs intact. Focused pure response literal delta changes exact route field facts/decisions without actor-admission or terminal-effect scenarios. Same-source CLI baseline independently yielded zero decisions/scenarios.
assessment.schema_and_conformance: No need for a v5 bump was found for the additive open-object facet: existing field inventory, envelope slots, canonicalization identifier and hash algorithm remain intact; compiler source provenance binds the new helper and changed parent. Semantic-set sorting is an existing contract and is not waived by keeping v5. Rehashed source-row and route-operation omissions reject against a fresh subject in independent focused tests. Static/non-releasable labels and null binary attestation remain explicit.
